tks_40_elements.title: Spiritual Mind
tks_40_elements.definition: Spiritual Mind at the highest degree is the 1st CAUSE of all causes, The Divine Mind commonly known as God who birthed all ideas, whom is within all & whom all is within. On the other hand men can be spiritual minded indeed in our true identity we are a spirit mind. However we usually are blind to our true selves because of our lower appetites and passions. To be spiritual minded means to be connected to the spirit world, to have insight into the spirit realm to know the Divine the Ultimate purpose of a thing, matter, or person, the absorbing of spiritual information, being in tune with the spirit of a thing, or when the Holy Spirit is the driver of one's actions and decisions.

tks_40_elements.title: Spiritual Positive
tks_40_elements.definition: Spiritual Positive is that which helps evolve the soul, brings it closer to God, to being God & also puts the soul at peace, undisturbed, & tranquil, at ease. It agrees with one's religious or spiritual constitution. It is truth that reinforces or reaffirms one's spiritual beliefs, a moral lesson, virtue.

tks_40_elements.title: Spiritual Negative
tks_40_elements.definition: Spiritual Negative is that which either disturbs the soul and or hinders the soul's spiritual evolution. Spirits that intend to harm, hurt, or cause pain and fear to the soul. That which the soul is task to come to grips with however causing it turmoil. Vice.

tks_40_elements.title: Spiritual Vibration
tks_40_elements.definition: Spiritual Vibration is aether energy, psychic energy. It is the base energy to all other energies, the frequency denoting a thing's purpose in the Grand Scheme of things, the aura.

tks_40_elements.title: Spiritual Female
tks_40_elements.definition: Spiritual Female is the souls yearning for spiritual content necessary to evolve it, the portion of the soul that knows what it needs to grow spiritually, protects, and nurtures the soul, as a spiritual womb or matrix of sorts, archetypically the Divine Mother or Amma of the 1st CAUSE.

tks_40_elements.title: Spiritual Male
tks_40_elements.definition: Spiritual Male is spiritual practices and precepts that are stern and austere, that puts the soul through test and trial for the sake of its evolution. Archetypically the Heavenly Father, Abba in Hebrew, portion of the 1st CAUSE, the deliver, transmitter of spiritual influence.

tks_40_elements.title: Spiritual Rhythm
tks_40_elements.definition: Spiritual Rhythm is the ups and downs of life, one's spiritual journey through life as in one's natal chart or destiny.

tks_40_elements.title: Spiritual Above
tks_40_elements.definition: Spiritual Above is the inner meaning of a thing, the Mysteries of the inner sanctum and those who have been initiated into such, the true reality of a matter, the esoteric. An advanced soul highly evolved. It is high morals and ethics.

tks_40_elements.title: Spiritual Below
tks_40_elements.definition: Spiritual Below is outer meaning, the symbols that represents the higher or inner truth but it itself is empty and false, an inferior soul capable of only grasping the exoteric meaning of things, the uninitiated masses. Low morals and ethics.

tks_40_elements.title: Spiritual Idea
tks_40_elements.definition: Spiritual Idea is the manifestation of spiritual matters like the state of the soul, the True Self, all things pertaining to the spirit and the spirit world, a totally spiritual idea, an idea that is spirit, existing exclusively in the Akashic. The Akashic records is the database from where all Ideas derive and are stored, It is the Mind of God. It is the spiritual aspect of the thing.

tks_40_elements.title: Mental Mind
tks_40_elements.definition: Mental Mind is where the ego lies all memories and past experiences that have contributed to the personality is stored here. Processing information for the sake of continuously coming to conclusions concerned strictly with analyzing. Decision and action driven by stoical logic.

tks_40_elements.title: Mental Positive
tks_40_elements.definition: Mental Positive is to be mentally stable, mental clarity, optimistic out look, sane, and enlightened thought, benevolent, altruistic, thinking.

tks_40_elements.title: Mental Negative
tks_40_elements.definition: Mental Negative is to be confused and indecisive. A thought that disturbs one's mental state cognitive dissonance, insanity, a pessimistic outlook, malicious thinking.

tks_40_elements.title: Mental Vibration
tks_40_elements.definition: Mental Vibration is the energy resonating from one's mind, psychic energy. Manifesting as the electromagnetic waves emitted by the brain. Indicates the psychic states alpha, beta, delta, or theta. The degree with which a thought resonates with the mind its unique vibratory signature.

tks_40_elements.title: Mental Female
tks_40_elements.definition: Mental Female is right brain thinking, open mindedness, imaginative, creative, the subconscious mind.

tks_40_elements.title: Mental Male
tks_40_elements.definition: Mental Male is left brain thinking, rigid, closed minded, logical, and critical, the conscious mind.

tks_40_elements.title: Mental Rhythm
tks_40_elements.definition: Mental Rhythm is one's thought pattern, transition from one ego state to another, how often a particular thought occurs in one's mind.

tks_40_elements.title: Mental Above
tks_40_elements.definition: Mental Above is the comprehension and contemplation of complex matters, pondering issues of importance, lofty ideals, a high I.Q., astute intelligence, smart, or brilliant mind.

tks_40_elements.title: Mental Below
tks_40_elements.definition: Mental Below is the incapacity for comprehension. It is simplistic matters menial matters of low importance and the pondering of such matters.

tks_40_elements.title: Mental Idea
tks_40_elements.definition: Mental Idea is an idea perceived as being exclusively of the mind manifested solely in the mental world or solely in the mind. It is the mental aspect of a thing.

tks_40_elements.title: Emotional Mind
tks_40_elements.definition: Emotional Mind is awareness of feelings, whether one's own or others, when emotions drive one's decisions and actions, the ability to sort through one's emotions, emotional intelligence.

tks_40_elements.title: Emotional Positive
tks_40_elements.definition: Emotional Positive is feelings of happiness, joy, elation, calm, and tranquility, pleasurable emotions, love, comradery.

tks_40_elements.title: Emotional Negative
tks_40_elements.definition: Emotional Negative is feelings of heartache, sadness, anger, resentment, contempt, mixed emotions, loneliness, hate, etc.

tks_40_elements.title: Emotional Vibration
tks_40_elements.definition: Emotional Vibration is the feeling energy emitted by a person, thing, or event. Ambiance or general mood of a person, thing, place or event, its aura.

tks_40_elements.title: Emotional Female
tks_40_elements.definition: Emotional Female is compassion, sympathy, unconditional acceptance, sensuality, feelings feminine in character.

tks_40_elements.title: Emotional Male
tks_40_elements.definition: Emotional Male is aggression, pride, dominant, feelings masculine in character.

tks_40_elements.title: Emotional Rhythm
tks_40_elements.definition: Emotional Rhythm is mood swings, the pattern or sequence of feelings projected, an emotional roller coaster.

tks_40_elements.title: Emotional Above
tks_40_elements.definition: Emotional Above is the feelings brought about by enlightenment causing one to be above the usual emotions felt by the common masses. It is emotional resolve, the feelings caused by a healed soul or psyche, usually indescribable to the common mind, the feeling that comes with having control over one's own lower emotions.

tks_40_elements.title: Emotional Below
tks_40_elements.definition: Emotional Below is to be overwhelmed and controlled by way of emotions.

tks_40_elements.title: Emotional Idea
tks_40_elements.definition: Emotional Idea is the sheath of an Idea, the figurative smell, or ambiance an Idea carries, like waking from a dream and not remembering it but still sensing or feeling its presence. It is the emotional aspect of a thing.

tks_40_elements.title: Physical Mind
tks_40_elements.definition: Physical Mind is the brain organ. The vehicle through which the impalpable mind acts through, the hardware hosting the software, computers, calculators, and other artificial intelligent machines. The physical body and cellular make up.

tks_40_elements.title: Physical Positive
tks_40_elements.definition: Physical Positive is the parts of a thing that compliments one another causing it to function and operate according to its designed purpose, order and symmetrical things.

tks_40_elements.title: Physical Negative
tks_40_elements.definition: Physical Negative is misplaced or out of sync parts causing a thing to become dysfunctional according to its designed purpose. Disorder which causes disease and sickness, out of place, or unsymmetrical things.

tks_40_elements.title: Physical Vibration
tks_40_elements.definition: Physical Vibration is light, sound, radiation, gamma waves, etc., the electromagnetism or heatwave signature of a thing, particle oscillation.

tks_40_elements.title: Physical Female
tks_40_elements.definition: Physical Female is a woman, the female of a species, an orifice, hole, receptacle, receiver, the womb, nurturer or facilitator of the seed like soil.

tks_40_elements.title: Physical Male
tks_40_elements.definition: Physical Male is man, the male of a species, phallus, appendage, transmitter, deliverer or the seed.

tks_40_elements.title: Physical Rhythm
tks_40_elements.definition: Physical Rhythm is music, time (matter in motion through space), dance, song, sex, exercise, or any routine or pattern made by a series of physical movements.

tks_40_elements.title: Physical Above
tks_40_elements.definition: Physical Above is upward distance, heights, degrees of height, things of good quality material well put together or of a high grade, the social haves or the person of high social status.

tks_40_elements.title: Physical Below
tks_40_elements.definition: Physical Below is that which is under something else's height, a thing of low quality, low physical integrity, poorly put together material, or of a low grade, societal have nots, persons of low social status.

tks_40_elements.title: Physical Idea
tks_40_elements.definition: Physical Idea is an idea that is entirely physical, manifested in the physical world. It is dead matter, the physical aspect of a thing.

tks_28_foundations.title: Spiritual desire to be and be with God
tks_28_foundations.definition: The core drive to merge with the divine. Transcends ego, seeking ultimate truth and purpose. Manifests as meditation, prayer, contemplation. Drives mystical experiences and enlightenment quests. Fuels the search for life's deepest meaning. Can lead to self-sacrifice or extreme devotion. Paradoxically involves both self-annihilation and self-realization.

tks_28_foundations.title: Spiritual wisdom, insight, and knowledge
tks_28_foundations.definition: The hunger for spiritual understanding beyond mundane facts. Seeks hidden truths, esoteric knowledge, and cosmic insights. Drives study of sacred texts, mystical traditions, and occult practices. Aims to perceive reality's underlying structure and laws. Can manifest as prophecy, clairvoyance, or profound intuition. Often involves decoding symbols and extracting meaning from synchronicities.

tks_28_foundations.title: Spiritual life, vitality, and health
tks_28_foundations.definition: The aspiration for soul-level vigor and wholeness. Seeks alignment with universal life force or prana. Manifests in practices like Qi Gong, Reiki, or energy healing. Aims to purify the subtle body and balance chakras. Can involve astral projection or lucid dreaming to explore non-physical realms. Strives for spiritual immunity against negative energies and entities.

tks_28_foundations.title: Spiritual companionship, love, and friendship
tks_28_foundations.definition: The longing for soul-deep connections transcending physical reality. Seeks twin flames, soul groups, or spiritual lineages. Manifests in guru-disciple relationships or mystical orders. Aims for unconditional love and telepathic bonds. Can involve communication with non-physical entities or ancestors. Strives to dissolve the illusion of separation between all beings.

tks_28_foundations.title: Spiritual worldly power, influence, and control
tks_28_foundations.definition: The drive to shape reality through will and consciousness. Seeks mastery over spiritual laws and forces. Manifests in ritual magic, reality manipulation, or psychic abilities. Aims to influence events, heal at a distance, or command spiritual entities. Can involve battling dark forces or exerting authority in non-physical realms. Strives for god-like creative power and cosmic influence.

tks_28_foundations.title: Spiritual material food and things
tks_28_foundations.definition: The hunger for divine sustenance and celestial objects. Seeks to consume spiritual energies, light, or prana. Manifests in practices like sun-gazing or breatharianism. Aims to acquire or manipulate spiritual artifacts and talismans. Can involve alchemy to transmute base matter into divine essence. Strives to perceive and interact with the etheric blueprint of physical reality.

tks_28_foundations.title: Spiritual lust, sex, and reproduction
tks_28_foundations.definition: The drive for divine union and cosmic creation. Seeks to harness and elevate sexual energy for spiritual purposes. Manifests in Tantric practices, sex magic, or sacred sexuality. Aims to awaken Kundalini and achieve spiritual rebirth. Can involve union with deity forms or non-physical entities. Strives to create on spiritual planes and birth new realities through focused intention.

tks_28_foundations.title: Mental desire to be and be with God
tks_28_foundations.definition: The mind's quest to comprehend the incomprehensible. Rational thought grappling with infinite concepts. Cognitive dissonance between human limitations and divine vastness. Mental models constantly evolving to approach godly understanding. Intellectual humility in the face of cosmic mysteries. Thoughts as prayers, consciousness as communion.

tks_28_foundations.title: Mental wisdom, insight, and knowledge
tks_28_foundations.definition: Cultivating discernment through rigorous analysis and intuition. Pattern recognition across diverse fields of study. Synthesizing information to extract fundamental truths. Mental flexibility to adapt to new paradigms. Critical thinking balanced with open-mindedness. Continuous learning as a lifelong mental discipline.

tks_28_foundations.title: Mental life, vitality, and health
tks_28_foundations.definition: Cognitive resilience in face of stress and trauma. Neuroplasticity as key to mental growth and healing. Mindfulness to sustain mental clarity. Balancing analytical and creative thinking for well-rounded mental health. Mental stimulation as essential nourishment for the brain. Curiosity as the engine of mental vitality.

tks_28_foundations.title: Mental companionship, love, and friendship
tks_28_foundations.definition: Intellectual compatibility. Shared mental models enhancing mutual understanding. Cognitive empathy. Collaborative problem-solving strengthening relationships. Mental challenges and growth as shared experiences. Balancing individuality and unity in thought processes. Thinking alike, group-think.

tks_28_foundations.title: Mental worldly power, influence, and control
tks_28_foundations.definition: To control, influence, others' or self with one's mind whether psychically, intellectually, or through strategic thinking. Making sense out of complex systems. Persuasive communication rooted in logical argumentation. Understanding cognitive biases to influence decision-making. Mental discipline to maintain focus on long-term goals. Ethical reasoning to guide use of mental influence.

tks_28_foundations.title: Mental material food and things
tks_28_foundations.definition: Cognitive frameworks as efficient resources of mental fuel and food for thought. Mental models and thought substance whether images, thought-forms or inner monologue. Intellectual property as intangible yet vital asset. Schools of thought, doctrines, entertainment that seeks to occupy the mind's attention. Conceptualizing sustainability through systems thinking.

tks_28_foundations.title: Mental lust, sex, and reproduction
tks_28_foundations.definition: Yearning for intellectual debate, intellectual exercise, to be bored out of one's mind and or spread the ideas one holds replicating one's mentality in the mind of another.

tks_28_foundations.title: Emotional desire to be and be with God
tks_28_foundations.definition: Overwhelming longing for divine connection. Ecstatic joy in perceived presence of the sacred. Deep comfort in surrendering to a higher power. Intense awe and wonder at the vastness of creation. Profound peace when feeling aligned with divine will. Aching emptiness when sensing separation from the divine. Being 'raptured' or feeling intense spiritual union with God.

tks_28_foundations.title: Emotional wisdom, insight, and knowledge
tks_28_foundations.definition: Gut feelings guiding important decisions. Empathetic understanding of others' emotional states. Intuitive flashes providing sudden clarity. Emotional intelligence navigating complex social situations. Heart-centered knowing transcending rational thought. Deep trust in one's emotional compass for life choices.

tks_28_foundations.title: Emotional life, vitality, and health
tks_28_foundations.definition: Vibrant enthusiasm for life's experiences. Resilient joy bouncing back from setbacks. Cathartic release through emotional expression. Peaceful contentment in emotional balance. Energizing passion driving personal growth. Healing warmth of self-compassion and acceptance.

tks_28_foundations.title: Emotional companionship, love, and friendship
tks_28_foundations.definition: Heart-swelling affection for close ones. Soul-deep resonance with kindred spirits. Vulnerability creating profound intimacy. Empathetic bonds transcending words. Unconditional acceptance fostering secure attachments. Joyful camaraderie in shared emotional journeys.

tks_28_foundations.title: Emotional worldly power, influence, and control
tks_28_foundations.definition: Confidence surging from personal empowerment. Satisfaction in emotionally moving others. Thrill of charismatic leadership. Frustration when emotions are manipulated. Pride in emotional self-mastery. Compassionate use of emotional intelligence to guide others. To control one's emotions and or control or influence the emotions of another.

tks_28_foundations.title: Emotional material food and things
tks_28_foundations.definition: Comfort derived from familiar possessions. Excitement of acquiring desired objects. Nostalgic attachment to meaningful items. Gratitude for life's material blessings. Emotional nourishment from aesthetically pleasing surroundings. Contentment in simple material pleasures.

tks_28_foundations.title: Emotional lust, sex, and reproduction
tks_28_foundations.definition: Passionate desire for physical intimacy. Tender affection in romantic partnerships. Primal urges driving sexual attraction. Emotional bonding through shared vulnerability. Nurturing instincts towards offspring. Complex emotions surrounding fertility and reproduction. To get another to feel how one feels. To replicate one's feeling inside the heart of another.

tks_28_foundations.title: Physical desire to be and be with God
tks_28_foundations.definition: Bodily expressions of spiritual longing. Manifests in prostration, fasting, flagellation. Seeks altered states through physical deprivation or exertion. Drives pilgrimages, ascetic practices, extreme endurance rituals. Can lead to bodily neglect or self-harm. Strives to transcend physical limitations through flesh.

tks_28_foundations.title: Physical wisdom, insight, and knowledge
tks_28_foundations.definition: Embodied cognition and somatic awareness. Manifests in muscle memory, reflexes, instincts. Seeks knowledge through direct physical experience. Drives development of martial arts, yoga, tactile learning. Can lead to over-reliance on physical sensing. Strives for perfect mind-body integration.

tks_28_foundations.title: Physical life, vitality, and health
tks_28_foundations.definition: Optimization of bodily functions and longevity. Manifests in fitness regimes, nutrition science, biohacking. Seeks peak physical performance and disease resistance. Drives development of sports medicine, anti-aging technologies. Can lead to orthorexia or exercise addiction. Strives for superhuman physical capabilities.

tks_28_foundations.title: Physical companionship, love, and friendship
tks_28_foundations.definition: Tactile expressions of bonding and affection. Manifests in hugging, grooming, co-sleeping behaviors. Seeks physical proximity and touch. Drives development of cuddle therapies, contact sports, dance. Can lead to touch addiction or boundary issues. Strives for constant physical connection with others.

tks_28_foundations.title: Physical worldly power, influence, and control
tks_28_foundations.definition: Dominance through bodily strength and presence. Manifests in bodybuilding, intimidation tactics, physical territorialism. Seeks to control space and resources through physical means. Drives development of weapons, armor, physical enhancements. Can lead to violence and tyranny. Strives for unbeatable physical superiority.

tks_28_foundations.title: Physical material food and things
tks_28_foundations.definition: Accumulation and consumption of tangible resources. Manifests in hoarding, gluttony, conspicuous consumption. Seeks security and status through physical possessions. Drives agriculture, manufacturing, resource extraction. Can lead to obesity, environmental destruction. Strives for unlimited physical abundance.

tks_28_foundations.title: Physical lust, sex, and reproduction
tks_28_foundations.definition: Bodily drive for pleasure and procreation. Manifests in sexual practices, fertility rites, genetic selection. Seeks to maximize reproductive success and sensual enjoyment. Drives development of contraceptives, sex toys, fertility treatments. Can lead to sexual addiction or objectification. Strives for peak physical pleasure and optimal offspring.
